title: Flying Speed Bonus│飛行速度加成
description: Speed ​​and Slowness effects affect flying speed.│迅捷與緩速效果會影響飛行速度。
body:
# Function│功能
- Each level of Speed ​​increases flight speed by 20%; each level of Slowness decreases flight speed by 15%. Only applies to flyable creatures.│每級迅捷效果提升20%飛行速度；每級緩速降低15%飛行速度。僅適用於可飛行生物。
